verdict.hook_line: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: Instead of throwing out her poisoned tormentor, the newly confirmed duchess forces her to work as a lowly scullery maid.
verdict.why_it_works: Delivers supreme psychological payback by forcing an arrogant villain into humiliating servitude.
